notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria with only a defect note. I created the full set of ACs from scratch based on the story context and technical notes. AC-1 establishes the core parity requirement (return trip discount matches one-way behavior). AC-2 addresses the likely root cause: the dispatch mapping producing null/undefined/zero for return trips. AC-3 covers the no-promo edge case. AC-4 and AC-5 cover percentage vs. fixed-amount discount types. AC-6 covers the edge case where discount exceeds fare. AC-7 ensures both legs of a round-trip are handled independently. AC-8 targets the return-trip modification mapper specifically, since that file was called out in technical notes and is the most likely location of the data loss.
